chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Lacey the violinist and his trouble
summary: Lacey, a violinist from Houston, leaves after being jailed over a young girl.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Fuqua was with the band playing guitar? Yeah. Let me tell you about that. When Lacey left the band--
Why did he leave the band?
I don't know why, but he had a little trouble. To tell the truth, he was in jail, over a little young girl, but it wasn't his fault really; he got out of it later.
Where did you get him anyway, did you get him down in Texas?
Right, we got him in Houston.
